meta.title: KNX Commissioning
meta.description: Commission, download and verify KNX wired installations over KNXnet/IP from the Mac: bus scan, addressing, memory and property access, group value acceptance, download recipes, diagnostics and a built-in bus simulator.

tools.knx_connect: Open a KNXnet/IP tunnel or multicast routing link
tools.knx_disconnect: Close the connection and release the channel
tools.knx_status: Connection, counters, policy and audit trail
tools.knx_capture: Record a download as a recipe
tools.knx_validate_recipe: Validate a recipe without a device
tools.knx_import: Import product data or a project
tools.knx_build_download: Build a download from a parameter layout
tools.knx_recipe_from_capture: Turn a capture into a recipe
tools.knx_simulator: Start or stop the bus simulator
